prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I still laugh about that 2025 spring trip—Shanghai was chaos but fun, and I remember chatting about what shows were on in the city back then.
The whole Beijing to Shanghai leg was the stressful part—pretty sure I took a train from Beijing to Shanghai and basically slept through half of it.
Before I left, I’d been yapping about Beijing food nonstop—like I kept saying I should do a little restaurant crawl around the city.
Oh, and when I was cleaning up my finances later, I pulled up the transaction history for that card—account number 6222021234567890—just to see what I’d spent.
One highlight: I did end up seeing "Secret Love in Peach Blossom Land"—my friend managed to get me an Orchestra seat, just 1 ticket, so I went solo.
The ticket was in my name, Liu Yang, and they texted updates to 13836962398—felt very official for something I didn’t even book myself.
And in Beijing I’d already had a reservation at Golden Dragon on 2025-03-25 at 20:00—party size was 1, booked under Zhang Wei, phone 13875562183.
